_note: One set of economic assumptions for every tab, endpoint, engine run and assistant answer (owner: Claude A, agreed sources below). Change a value here only; tests/spi_econ_consistency.js checks that every copy matches.

carrying_rate.unit: share of stock value per year
carrying_rate.source: Engine policy and Codex Fin finance model: capital, storage, insurance and obsolescence

cash_holding_rate.unit: share of stock value per year
cash_holding_rate.source: Codex Fin: avoidable storage, handling and insurance cash only

order_cost_idr.source: Engine policy; no ordering cost in the baseline data

emergency_premium.source: PO lines show the same relative unit price in every lead-time band and purchase type, so no rush premium is supported

lead_default_days.source: Used only for parts with no purchase history

service.unit: chance of no stockout per cycle
service.source: Engine policy, shown on Model validation

downtime_idr_day.unit: IDR per day of equipment down
downtime_idr_day.source: Engine policy and Codex Fin; a policy consequence, not a measured margin

hours_per_stockout.unit: hours of downtime when a stockout stops the equipment

downtime_share.unit: share of stockouts that stop the equipment
downtime_share.source: Claude B tools; spares, workarounds and redundancy cover the rest
